tp4-ar.rationale: Report the maximum nonnegative repeat upper CI95 for pooled mean and top-one, the largest category point increase and net tail count. Deterministic repeat spread does not bound legitimate neutral numerics changes. Retain the reviewed proposal: 0.005-nat pooled upper CI95, 0.01-nat category point mean, 1% pooled top-one upper CI95, Holm alpha 0.05 and two net tail positions above 0.5 nats. The accepted alpha.2 TP2-versus-TP4 neutral evidence passes these rules. Operator approved the procedure on 2026-10-03 and corrected margin adoption on 2026-10-04; zero repeat spread must not adopt zero margins.

limitations: Quick is a bounded smoke screen, not full release qualification.
External evidence must come from this release; the operator must verify its deployment provenance.

MOPD alpha: teacher, exact verify and multimodal gate against GPU reference runner F32 references of the MOPD checkpoint (fixtures/mimo26/README.md); vLLM captures are informational. A passing alpha screen is not full numerical qualification. Release preview still requires current-run GSM8K >=193/200 in both arms and the declared speculative-verification bounds; C1 greedy differences are informational.

Audio is served but not qualified in-tree (capabilities.unqualified_media): the repository holds no audio reference input, so the multimodal, mixed-media, soak and encoder parity checks carry no audio items. The audio front end's preprocessing is still checked against torchaudio on generated signals. Test audio with your own inputs.

Declared preprocessing deviation: ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and std [0.229, 0.224, 0.225] replace checkpoint CLIP statistics. The 349-probe paired F32 study favors ImageNet (205 wins, p = 0.0013); docs/serving-mimo26.md#solid-color-images.
Declared preprocessing deviation: images are capped at 1048576 pixels (1024 image tokens) for serving resources; docs/reference-runner.md#frontend-preprocessing.

Declared preprocessing deviation: image minimum 8192 pixels, retaining bicubic. Accuracy evidence: 3136 loses 14/21 scenes (mean -1.73 nats; eight losses of 3.4-5.7), with probe sign p=0.0088 and scene t-test p approximately 0.003 despite scene sign p=0.189; small images retain 9 rather than 4 tokens. docs/serving-mimo26.md#image-resize-reference.

spec_continuation (adopted 2026-10-15) gates tp4-dflash on its own continuations after speculative/AR divergence: each arm's emitted tokens are teacher-forced through the GPU reference runner in the pinned teacher reference's F32 and BF16 modes and judged by the unchanged spread-rule limits with the AR control as validity check (docs/numerics.md#speculative-continuations). It adds no paired margin; the 2026-10-06 DFlash pooled verify-row waiver is unchanged. Its candidate-minus-AR and KL figures are reported, not gated.

spec_greedy.reason: DFlash speculative output is gated by the spec_verify copy-set bounds and paired GSM8K; C1 greedy token and finish differences from AR are reported, not gated

preview.numerical_reference: teacher gated against the GPU reference runner F32 reference of the MOPD checkpoint

unqualified_media.audio: Served, but not qualified in-tree: the repository holds no audio reference input. Test audio with your own inputs.
